title: The Lighthouse Keeper's Last Visitor 🕯️
character: an old lighthouse keeper, thin, grey beard, yellow raincoat

scenes.narration: Every night for forty years, someone knocked on the lighthouse door at midnight.
scenes.image_prompt: a lonely lighthouse on a cliff at night

scenes.narration: Old Tomas never opened it. His father had warned him, and his grandfather before that.
scenes.image_prompt: an old keeper by a window

scenes.narration: But tonight the storm was louder than ever, and the knocking sounded like a child crying.
He lifted the latch. Rain swept in. The doorstep was empty, except for small wet footprints.
The footprints led inside. Up the stairs. Toward the lamp room, where he had left his lantern burning.
In the morning the lamp was dark, and two sets of footprints walked out to sea.
scenes.image_prompt: footprints into the sea at dawn

description: A lighthouse keeper finally opens the door.
